Hi, I’m Kristen.

I’m a graphic designer who likes making things for the web.

Designer, problem-solver, and professional perfectionist.

I’m a graphic designer with a particular interest in **web design, UX/UI, and digital accessibility**. I love taking something complicated and figuring out how to make it feel simple, intuitive, and maybe even a little fun.

My approach to design is rooted in curiosity. I want to understand the *why* behind a project before jumping into the *how*. Who is using it? What do they need? What could make their experience easier?

Design should have no unnecessary barriers.

My interest in accessibility comes from believing that the web should be designed with **real people** in mind.

Different abilities, devices, environments, and ways of interacting with technology all change how someone experiences a website. Accessibility should always be a part of the design process, not a checklist at the end of a project.

For me, accessible design is simply **good design with more people included.**

A little more about me

I’m happiest when I’m creating, experimenting, or learning something I didn’t know yesterday.

I’m the type of designer who will spend way too long adjusting a tiny detail because *I know it could be better*. I love clean layouts, thoughtful typography, and finding those little details that make an experience feel special.

Outside of design, you’ll probably find me at the gym, spending time with friends, or taking Pokémon Go a little too seriously.
